description.describe_ch: 對數據進行統計分析，需以數據的機率分佈為起始點。本課程內容包含介紹機率名詞、常用離散型，連續型隨機變量，及其對應機率分佈與相關性質、聯合機率分佈函數。結合資訊工具，設計並模擬生活中可見的機率架構。此課程實施將側重於解題，並以作業、小考、報告等來進行檢核。
description.describe_eh: Statistical data analysis is based on the probability distributions of data obtained.This course contains introduction of basic terminologies in probability; common discrete and continuous random variables, corresponding distributions and properties; joint probability distribution.Combine information tools to design and simulate the probability structure in life.The implementation of this course will focus on problem solving, and will be checked with homework, tests, reports, etc.

targets.describe_ch: 認識基本機率名詞； 機率基本性質；隨機變量；機率分佈函數與累積分配函數； 熟悉期望值與變異數之計算
targets.describe_en: Knowledge of basic terminologies in probability；basic properties；  random variable； probability distribution function and cumulative distribution function； Capability of calculating expectation and variance.

targets.describe_ch: 了解常用離散型隨機變量，及其對應機率分佈與相關性質
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for common discrete random variables, corresponding distributions, and properties.

targets.describe_ch: 了解常用連續型隨機變量，及其對應機率分佈與相關性質
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for common continuous random variables, corresponding distributions, and properties.

targets.describe_ch: 了解一組隨機變量的聯合機率分佈函數，及衍生之統計量與其分佈
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for joint probability distribution of random variables; and statistics of random variables and corresponding distributions.
